focus.jnote: The macro tape is loaded today — even as oil gave ground. Core PCE, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, prints at 8:30 AM ET, with the Dow Jones consensus looking for ~0.3% m/m on both headline and core and ~3.3% y/y core — still well above the 2% target. The BEA's methodology revision back to 2021 could pull the July annual reading lower, muddying the signal. Oil fell toward $89 Tuesday after the U.S. ordered another SPR release and Saudi exports recovered to ~98% of pre-war levels, which eased some inflation fear. But the 10-year yield sits near ~5.25%, a 2007 high, the 30-year has topped 5.6% (a 2002 level), and markets price ~70% odds of an October hike. Gold slid near $4,100 as yields and the dollar firmed. Then Micron reports after the close — a print that swings the entire AI-memory complex. This is a headline-and-data tape, not one a Sniper sells premium into.
focus.notdown: Energy (XLE, XOM, CVX, OXY) retains a war-premium bid on the unresolved Iran/Hormuz standoff, but the group just took a hit as oil dropped ~3.8% on the SPR release and Saudi export recovery — proof this is a two-sided war trade, not a clean Sniper. One supply or de-escalation headline gaps any bull put the wrong way. The scanner examined the full universe and boarded nothing here. Watch-only, not a table-pounder.
focus.notup: Rate-sensitive growth & long-duration tech stay pressured with the 10Y at 2007 highs and October-hike odds near 70% — and Micron's after-the-close print makes the whole semis complex a coin-flip into tonight. But selling bear calls into a data-and-earnings tape ahead of PCE and Friday's payrolls carries violent squeeze risk on any soft-data or beat headline — the disciplined answer is to sell nothing new today. The scanner confirms it: zero bearish names cleared confirmation.
focus.why: Why RED? Composite ~63 is deep in WARM and P(≥1% gap) at 40% is above the 35% trigger — either alone locks out GREEN. Decisively, core PCE inside the next 24h is a market-moving release that cannot be GREEN under the rules, and it stacks on top of Micron AMC, a bond market at 2007-high yields, and Friday's jobs report. And the full-universe scanner boarded ZERO names — nothing survived to a confirmed gap or breakout today. Stand down on new credit spreads, or push DTE past the data window and cut size hard. Cash is a position today.
